svg.title: Plate II-05.1. Novelty and validity are separate axes
svg.desc: A two-by-two field: novelty relative to a named record against validity as far as tests reached, with Part II cases placed in three of the four cells, a ledger of the record fields that keep the axes apart, and three small timelines asking which event each date marks.

text.font-family: 'LIA Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace
'LIA Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: NEW TO WHOM, AND AS OF WHEN

text.font-family: 'LIA Boska', Boska, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Novelty and validity are separate axes

text.font-family: 'LIA Boska', Boska, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Is the claim new, relative to a named record at a named date? Is it true, as far as the appropriate tests have reached? The answers are independent. The cases in Part II

text.font-family: 'LIA Boska', Boska, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: fill three of the four combinations.

svg.text: A single label hides one axis. “Rediscovered” alone says nothing about truth;

text.font-family: 'LIA Boska', Boska, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: “validated” alone says nothing about whether anyone knew it before.
